This tests that undoManager keeps DOMTransaction objects aliveduring its lifetime and therefore does not crash after the GC runs.

On success, you will see a series of "PASS" messages, followed by "TEST COMPLETE".


PASS gc(); document.undoManager.undo(); result is "execute undo "
PASS gc(); document.undoManager.redo(); result is "execute undo redo "
PASS successfullyParsed is true

TEST COMPLETE
